title: Y-Axis Movement or Step Distance Issues After Using the Rotary Attachment
body_html:
Y-Axis Movement or Step Distance Issues After Using the Rotary Attachment

Problem Description

After using the rotary attachment on the XRF, the Y-axis may not move as expected when switching back to normal engraving. The movement distance or step distance may also be incorrect, affecting the machine's positioning accuracy.

Cause

The rotary mode setting in LightBurn may still be enabled. When rotary mode is active, the Y-axis movement is adjusted to accommodate the rotary attachment. If the machine returns to normal engraving without properly resetting its operating state, Y-axis movement or step distance may be abnormal.

Solution

  1. Open LightBurn and go to Tools > Rotary Setup.
  2. Uncheck Enable Rotary to disable rotary mode.
  3. Press the Reset button on the machine's control panel, or restart the machine.
  4. Run a test to confirm that the Y-axis movement and step distance have returned to normal.

Note: After using the rotary attachment, make sure to disable rotary mode and reset or restart the machine before returning to normal engraving. If the issue persists, check the machine's settings and contact technical support if necessary.

 

 

Important Reminder:

If these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on ZOHO: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket. A technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
